changelog:
remote-skill-test v1.0.0 — Initial release.

- Enables end-to-end testing of agent skills on a remote jump host via SSH.
- Automates skill installation, test execution, report retrieval, and result comparison on the remote host.
- Requires SSH/SCP access, npx, and opencode installed on the target.
- Collects target skill name, SSH config, and prompt from the user before proceeding.
- Ensures all output language (Chinese/English) matches the user's input language throughout the process.
summary: Use when the user wants to test an agent skill on a remote jump host after updating it locally. Triggers on "test skill remotely", "remote test", "远程测试 skill...
